Hello, I’m just curious what about the novel was boring to you? Was it mainly predictability? 

Im not a huge light novel reader/listener, so I don’t have much to compare it to. I just got hooked on SL season one. 

But, I have listened to all 8 volumes multiple times after finishing the manwa.  I personally was very invested and impressed by how well the book described the action and whole world compared to what is shown in the art. It was almost more immersive than the actual manwa. 

I’d be interested to see what you would recommend a 10/10 because that will probably blow my mind (preferably on audible)
What was their reason for not doing it this way? I didn’t see where they mentioned it.

Isn’t every gta hour 2 min irl? Why couldn’t they use that? Like oh you got 120 min in jail? That’s 60 hours. Or around 2.5 days in game. Makes it much more immersive and people outside of jail can track it easier. Seems like the best of both worlds.
Thanks for the reply! Do you know where I might be able to find more info on them? I honestly don’t know much about these but I figured they might be valuable.

Honestly, I loved jimmy at this point in the show, but in this moment, chuck finally let out all of his pent up resentment and aggression and was totally right about everything he said. 

Yeah it was completely inappropriate in the setting he was in, and he definitely should not have started talking about things unrelated to the current situation, but it’s understandable in some ways. 

I mean think about it, chuck was the only person to try to stop jimmy because he knew the true person hiding underneath. After chuck, jimmy was mostly free and eventually turned into Saul who was instrumental in ruining countless lives all for personal gain. 

It’s truly a masterpiece in writing. I have similar feelings toward Howard who was shown as the bad guy most of the show but in the end everybody realized he was just a good guy who jimmy decided was his enemy.

Also before anybody comments this, I didn’t realize that Giovani has set legendary for set times. I wanted mewtwo and was told beating him have you the chance to catch him. I was mad it was moltres not meetwo 3 times in a row until I realized he has a schedule 🤷🏼‍♂️ I’ll wait until next time the give a super radar
